name: stop_goal
description: Cancel only the active find_target goal and its search, navigation, tracking, or approach step. Trigger phrases include 'stop searching', 'stop looking for it', 'cancel the search', 'forget finding the bottle', and 'stop going to the kitchen'. Do not use this to stop following a person, passive person-looking, or an explicit movement.

name: stop_navigation
description: Cancel active explicit or automatic hand-guided movement. Trigger phrases include 'stop moving', 'stop navigation', 'cancel that movement', 'don't go there', and 'halt'. Do not use this for continuous follow_person, find_target, or passive watch-target tracking.

name: stop_follow
description: Stop only the active continuous follow_person movement. Shared visual tracking may continue so the robot can keep watching the person. Trigger phrases include 'stop following me', 'don't follow me', 'wait here', 'stay here', and 'stop trailing that person'. Do not use this merely because the robot is looking at a person without following.

name: stop_watching_target
description: Stop a watch_target acquisition or its passive camera tracking, and recenter the camera. Trigger phrases include 'stop looking', 'stop watching it', 'look away', 'don't track me', and 'you can stop watching now'. Do not interrupt tracking owned by find_target, follow_person, or automatic hand guidance.
